messages.subject: Month-end reminder: time entry due by 5pm Friday
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

A reminder that all October time must be entered and released by 5pm this Friday for month-end billing. Several matters currently show gaps. Please also clear any unallocated disbursements.

Thank you,
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
